title: Cross-User Adaptation for sEMG Gesture Recognition via Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.34011v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prosthetic and assistive interfaces increasingly depend on decoding hand gestures from surface electromyography (sEMG). Because the signal is shaped by person-specific factors, the recurrent neural networks (RNNs) commonly used to model these temporal streams must adapt to new wearers and new gesture classes after deployment. Continual learning (CL) enables this adaptation without retraining from scratch, yet applying it to recurrent sEMG models is not straightforward. Standard recurrent training practices can destabilize learning, and which CL strategy holds up under realistic cross-user drift is unestablished. We evaluate three representative CL strategies under domain- and class-incremental drift on NinaPro DB1, and find experience replay to outperform elastic weight consolidation (EWC) and naive fine-tuning. It reaches 83.3% final accuracy for class-incremental drift while limiting forgetting to 1.8-5.8% accuracy drop, as against 16.

translated_title: 基于持续学习的sEMG手势识别跨用户自适应
translated_abstract: 假肢和辅助接口越来越依赖于从表面肌电信号（sEMG）中解码手部手势。由于信号受到个体特异性因素的影响，常用于建模此类时间流的循环神经网络（RNN）必须在部署后适应新的佩戴者和新的手势类别。持续学习（CL）能够实现这种适应而无需从头重新训练，但将其应用于循环sEMG模型并非易事。标准的循环训练实践可能导致学习不稳定，且哪种CL策略能够在现实的跨用户漂移下保持有效尚未确立。我们在NinaPro DB1数据集上评估了三种代表性的CL策略在域增量和类增量漂移下的表现，发现经验回放优于弹性权重固化（EWC）和朴素微调。在类增量漂移下，经验回放达到83.3%的最终准确率，同时将遗忘控制在1.8-5.8%的准确率下降范围内，相比之下朴素微调的遗忘高达16……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文在NinaPro DB1数据集上系统评估了三种持续学习策略在跨用户sEMG手势识别中的表现，发现经验回放以83.3%的最终准确率和仅1.8-5.8%的遗忘率显著优于弹性权重固化和朴素微调。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates three continual learning strategies for cross-user sEMG gesture recognition on NinaPro DB1, showing that experience replay significantly outperforms EWC and naive fine-tuning, achieving 83.3% final accuracy with only 1.8-5.8% forgetting.
